name: ChatGPT for Financial Services
desc: A ChatGPT build for banks, with licensed data and admin controls.
desc_zh: 面向银行的 ChatGPT 版本，带授权数据源和管理员控制。
solves: A general assistant cannot cite a licensed dataset, and IT cannot govern it. This build carries the firm’s own entitlements and sits inside ChatGPT’s enterprise controls.
solves_zh: 通用助手无法引用授权数据集，IT 也管不住它。这个版本带着机构自己的授权范围，并落在 ChatGPT 的企业管控之内。
best_for: An analyst needs an answer that names the dataset it came from.
best_for_zh: 分析师需要一个能说清数据来自哪里的答案。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — OpenAI news, https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-financial-services）。 Gated availability: the page states it is available to eligible financial institutions and directs interested parties to contact sales, so there is no self-serve public entry. Access to S&P Capital IQ, LSEG, MSCI, Dow Jones Factiva and Moody’s data is via shared sign-in. 首次公开日期来源：https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-financial-services
